ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, APRIL 1, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

Vivian Shimoyama, Chair  Nima Novin, Commissioner
John Thomas, Vice Chair  Andy Perez, Commissioner
Erica Jacquez, Commissioner  Jayro Sandoval, Commissioner
Austin Metoyer, Commissioner  Robert Smith, Commissioner
Miles Nevin, Commissioner  Brenda Wunsch, Commissioner
Kevin Noertker, Commissioner

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  econdevcommission@longbeach.gov

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54401 Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Economic Development
  Commission meeting of Wednesday, February 4, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54708 Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the Port of Long Beach,
  including an overview of the Department and its initiatives.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54710 Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the Long Beach Council of
  Business Associations (COBA) and Business Improvement Districts (BIDs).

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54711 Recommendation to receive and file Executive Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Economic Development Commission on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS
